notes: Two added units here, both surplus on the English side by rule 42's counting: the coordinating 'and' before 'is without knowledge', which no waw licenses, and the possessive 'his' before 'graven image', which no suffix licenses.
'there is no breath in them' puts the presentative frame on the prepositional predicate בְּ under rules 20 and 49; the clause has no אַיִן, so rule 50 is not in play and לֹא keeps only 'no'.
